aurelion.desc: Aurelion, the Light-Drinker (boss, 7x; gilded plate - the only plate in the arc): grey-white cape, red-lit eyes, gold greatsword. cast = drinks a gold lamp (light_drain fx). die = sinks to his knees in a heap of gold light.

aurelion_p3.desc: Aurelion phase 3: drinking the Dawn-Flame - plate dulled, red leaks and gem (dawn_drink red ring fx, 3 s).

aurelion_wraith.desc: Aurelion P2 light-wraith copy (x3): pale, colour-dithered; NO shadow (the real one casts as_shadow) - hit the one with a shadow.

aurelion_rest.desc: Aurelion rest / befriend pose (outro 6.4): on one knee, sword planted point-down. idle = breathing; walk slot = a slow shuffle variant of the kneel.
